items.a: Yes. You can request a free exterior inspection and estimate. We’ll confirm your project details and arrange a time after you submit the request.
items.q: Is the inspection and estimate free?

items.a: Daniel serves homeowners in Maryland, Washington, DC, and Northern Virginia. Share your ZIP code so we can confirm availability for your location and project.
We’ll discuss your concerns, inspect the relevant areas, and review findings and potential solutions. The time needed depends on the scope; we’ll clarify that when arranging your visit.
No. Tell me what you’re noticing and what you’d like to improve. We can compare materials, appearance, maintenance, and budget during the consultation.
items.q: Do I need to know which products I want?

items.a: Your project is through Presidential Exteriors. Ask Daniel to walk through the assigned installation team, relevant training, and how your project will be managed before you commit.
Yes. Ask about the options available for your project. Approval, rates, and terms depend on the program and application.
Coverage depends on the selected products, installation, and program. We’ll review the applicable written material and labor terms, exclusions, and transferability with your proposal.
items.q: What warranty comes with my project?

items.a: It sends an inspection request to Daniel. Your appointment is confirmed only after we connect and agree on a time.
